headline: Trump Proposes Mandating Data Centers Generate On-Site Electricity
summary: Donald Trump stated that data centers should generate their own power, amid growing community backlash over electricity demands, though energy analysts noted states hold primary regulatory authority.
why: Power consumption by AI data centers is straining utility grids, making grid connectivity and self-generation requirements a critical risk for technology real estate developers.

impacts.name: US Data Centers
impacts.why: Proposals to require independent power generation would increase capital expenditure requirements for new facilities.
